Prompt: CINEMATIC SETUP
Aerial dogfight | Battle of Britain 1940 | period war drama | summer afternoon
Multishot, HARD CUTs only at the specified points. Warm faded color film look, soft halation on highlights, 35 mm grain, hazy summer sky.

CHARACTERS
The British pilot: man, lean face, three-day stubble, an oil smudge across his left cheekbone. Scuffed brown leather flying helmet, goggles pushed up with one lens cracked at the corner, rubber oxygen mask hanging loose from one strap, sheepskin-collared leather jacket worn shiny at the cuffs.
The British fighter: single-seat monoplane with elliptical wings, olive-green and brown camouflage, red-white-blue roundels, paint chipped along the wing roots, an oil streak running back from the engine cowling.
The German fighter: single-seat monoplane with squared wingtips, gray mottled camouflage, bright yellow nose, black crosses on the fuselage, exhaust staining along the side.

LOCATION
Sky over the English Channel: towering white cumulus clouds, blue-gray sea below, and the white chalk cliffs of the English coast, as tall as forty humans stacked, topped by green fields.

TIMELINE
Shot 1 (0–4s): Extreme close-up inside the cockpit, FOV 47°, handheld with breath-like float. Sun glare across the canopy glass. The pilot's breath fogs inside the mask, his eyes scan ahead. He twists his head over his right shoulder: behind him, the German fighter drops out of a cloud bank, yellow nose pointing straight at him. His pupils tighten, jaw locks.
HARD CUT
Shot 2 (4–9s): Wide air-to-air tracking shot, FOV 63°, camera flying alongside. The German fighter closes from behind; glowing tracer lines streak past the British fighter's wingtip. The British fighter rolls onto its back and dives into a white cloud.
HARD CUT
Shot 3 (9–14s): Inside the cloud, total white-out for one second, then the British fighter bursts out 10 meters above the sea at 550 km/h, propeller wash kicking up a trail of spray. The German fighter emerges from the cloud behind it and follows.
HARD CUT
Shot 4 (14–19s): Low wide shot, FOV 84°, from just above the waves. The white cliffs fill the frame ahead. The British fighter pulls up hard and climbs along the cliff face, wingtip vapor trails peeling off. Cut-in close-up: the pilot's cheeks drag down under the g-force, teeth clenched. The German fighter overshoots past the cliff top.
HARD CUT
Shot 5 (19–24s): Over-the-shoulder close-up through the cockpit gunsight, FOV 29°. The German fighter now sits ahead in the ring sight. The pilot's gloved thumb presses the button on the control column; the wing guns flash in rapid bursts. Sparks hit the German engine cowling and thick black smoke pours out.
HARD CUT
Shot 6 (24–30s): Extreme wide, FOV 84°, slow pan. The German fighter trails a long black smoke line in a descending arc toward the sea; a white parachute opens beneath it. The British fighter banks slowly over the cliffs against the sun, its shadow sliding across the green fields.

PHYSICS
Aircraft weigh about 3,000 kg each and move with real inertia: wide banking arcs, no instant direction changes. Speeds 500–580 km/h. Smoke trails stay attached behind the aircraft and drift with the wind.

LIGHTING
Afternoon sun 5600K, high and slightly behind the British fighter, hard rim light on the canopy and wings, soft haze over the sea.

SFX
Sound: No score. Production audio only. Roaring piston engines, the pilot's breathing inside the mask, wind howl, rattle of wing guns, metal pings, sputtering engine, the long fading whine of the falling fighter, then only the steady drone of one engine.

QUALITY ANCHOR
Warm faded color film, 35 mm grain, period-accurate 1940 aircraft and flying gear.
No dialogue. Just the British fighter banking over the white cliffs, its shadow crossing the fields.
Face stable. Hands anatomically natural. Same pilot, same helmet and jacket in every shot. Exactly two aircraft in the sky, each keeping its own markings and colors throughout. The cliffs stay white chalk and appear only on the English side. Consistent grain and color across all shots.

CHARACTERS & SETTING

A composed 17-year-old Korean schoolgirl with a short black bob, straight bangs, grey school blazer, black tie, plaid skirt, white backpack, and black Converse sneakers stands inside a modern Korean city bus. The bus features blue seats, bright orange handrails, and large windows overlooking a busy city street. Four intimidating adult men surround her, dressed in dark streetwear, including one with bleached-blonde hair, a camouflage-print shirt, and tattooed arms.

SCENE 1 — THE AWAKENING (0–4 SECONDS)

A wide cinematic shot moves slowly down the bus aisle. The schoolgirl stands perfectly still as the men close in around her. A faint electric-blue aura begins shimmering around her body. A smartphone and a red soda can rise into the air, rotating slowly beside her face. Cut to an extreme close-up of her focused eyes, reflecting the mysterious blue light.

SCENE 2 — TIME STANDS STILL (4–8 SECONDS)

The blonde man suddenly lunges toward her. His fist rushes toward the camera in dramatic slow motion. Just inches from her face, his punch freezes in mid-air, stopped by an invisible force. The girl's expression remains completely calm. A subtle blue ripple spreads through the air as the camera captures the tension in a razor-sharp close-up.

SCENE 3 — LIGHTNING-FAST COMBAT (8–14 SECONDS)

The action explodes into motion. A low-angle shot captures her sneakers gripping the bus floor as she launches into a flawless spinning taekwondo kick. She evades incoming attacks with precise footwork, redirects her opponents' movements, and uses the orange handrails to pivot effortlessly through the aisle. Each movement feels powerful, fluid, and physically believable. Dynamic tracking shots alternate with sharp impact cuts and brief slow-motion moments.

SCENE 4 — TELEKINETIC POWER (14–22 SECONDS)

Two attackers charge simultaneously. The girl raises one hand, unleashing a concentrated blue shockwave that sends one man backward into the empty seats. Another is pushed away from her by an invisible force. Bags and loose objects lift into the air as the bus interior trembles slightly. Passengers duck behind the seats. Blue energy distorts the air for a split second, creating a spectacular supernatural effect without overpowering the realistic visual style.

SCENE 5 — THE FINAL STRIKE (22–27 SECONDS)

The last attacker charges directly toward her. She plants her feet, turns smoothly, and extends her palm. A brilliant blue energy burst fills the aisle, sending him stumbling backward onto the seats. Dust particles and tiny reflections shimmer through the light. The other men remain defeated and motionless for a moment, while the girl stands untouched and composed.

SCENE 6 — THE ICONIC EXIT (27–30 SECONDS)

The camera pulls back into a symmetrical wide shot of the bus aisle. The girl calmly straightens her blazer and adjusts her white backpack as the blue glow fades away.
